10th - kimpari 2/21/2026 11:23 PM
survivor 41 is hated for a lot of things. mainly
  • it is the introduction to the “new era,” which is very looked down upon by the vast majority of survivor fans. i can honestly say i have never met another survivor fan who’s watched most seasons and prefers the new era
  • it has a fuckload of advantages and twists. there’s the frustration that it fails to “let the players play the game,” with some twists being especially luck-based and several boots being a victim of something they could not have possibly have predicted
  • the editing is extremely lopsided, with much of it being dedicated to explaining those advantages and twists. one of the major players that season is notoriously invisible despite their role on the island, solely because they never interacted with any of the big advantages
  • and speaking of the edit: the winner’s edit is terrible. they get very little screentime, their game is undermined by an absurd amount (with much of their “mistakes” being fabricated by the edit), and many many casual fans thought that another player should’ve won instead
  • it is extremely woke. this is a really funny one to me. but pilot says it’s true but why do i like it? yes
  • i just don’t respect the game of survivor as much as other survivor fans, i think. i dont really get upset by “the spirit of the game” being diluted; some of the twists i laugh or roll my eyes at but in the end i don’t really care enough about the game to get mad about the random weird advantages
  • i genuinely think it has the best or second best cast of the new era. i love people, i think people are my biggest special interest. and i honestly love nearly every single character on this season. i could go on and on about this, but i must keep this concise… i also found many of the individual character storylines narratively satisfying, particularly the losing finalists
  • i find ricard to be extremely compelling. much of my opinion on a season hinges on one person i love and how far they make it; the only other castaway i like more than ricard is kim spradlin, but even she can only do so much to save her season lmao. ricard is an interesting strategist, amazingly levelheaded, ruthless but never cruel, very very likable, a challenge threat (i love challenge beasts), and vocally progressive. and he’s really hot. he is so hot
  • adding onto that: ricard’s storyline with shan is so intriguing. it is probably my favourite survivor narrative ever. the confessional where ricard just calmly says “so now i’ve decided, that now it’s time for shan to go” is chilling (but in a good way)!!
  • personally… i loved the winner and found them very satisfying. they are one of my favourites. i also think the edit really captured their gameplay even if it went too far in trying to hiding them lmao. utr queen.
  • the season is really woke. it’s the first season with the diversity mandate and it actually directly discusses (and celebrates!) that diversity. the black alliance, the conversations about poc, the fact that the f5 is MAJORITY QUEER, and the context that the season was filmed during the trial of derek chauvin… all of that makes it very poignant to me. not to wax too hard but survivor was originally a social experiment and i think s41’s active discussion of social issues makes it a really good example in that regard (imo!)

game layout

  • this is a returnee season that brought back someone of each placement from past seasons. i am representing 0th place as the only newbie player
  • every player has a legacy idol that they can will to a living player upon being voted out, upon which it will activate for 3 episodes. people can only play an advantage once during the game
  • each phase is a "season"
    • spring = additional individual kimmunity
    • summer = snippets of your chats with people get leaked
    • autumn = everyone gets an additional vote for tribal, and also there's an initial vote for a "president" who can choose between who gets eliminated between most votes and 2nd most votes
    • winter = the tribe or person who wins kimmunity is obscured. votes are obscured. advantages are obscured

  • the art was amazing, 12 idols *2 colours is insane plus the tribe logos, i especially liked the starting tribes and had fun incorporating them into my drawing of the season. this is why del is my favourite host
  • the seasons were terrible but they were terrible in a stockholm syndromey way so nice??? they did give me a great visual base to use for parches which was really fun
  • shadoweh coming to spec was huge for morale. really many of my friends in general but shadoweh actually paid attention to shit which makes her the best spec and she was robbed of the best spec award wtf!!
  • i really liked talking to slush despite everything. and also typo and volume i found super fun to talk to, it is rare i find myself enjoying non-game chats but volume managed it
  • the drawing challenge was super fun! i am very thankful to small might for coming up w that one, it was very scary but ended up feeling so rewarding. also it yielded one of the funniest moments of this game, unintentional 9/11
  • the returnee theme was really interesting! it’s not like i go around spectating a lot of orgs but the concept seemed very novel to me lmao. idk what i was expecting when pilot invited me under the premise that “it’s not a full returnee season, we’re looking at inviting 1-2 newbie players” but i think this idea is such a good combination of simple and creative
  • i liked the incorporation of vietnamese culture in the flavour a lot! not only the vietnamese zodiac (which is way better than the chinese zodiac btw) but also the vietnamese swap tribe names lmao. my late grandfather’s name is long so it was kinda cool to be on that tribe
  • this was probably the most chaotic org i’ve ever been part of. which again is not a lot. but it made for a very fun experience!yall still should’ve found some way to bring back courtney :( but there seemed to be quite a few characters on the cast regardless (even if their character might’ve been “impressively bland”) and that made the game fun
